_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: budgets_month_category_unique
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX budgets_month_category_unique ON budgets (month_key, IFNULL(category_id, '')) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 40), "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("color_hex" LIKE '#%'), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 40), "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("color_hex" LIKE '#%'), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_minor" BETWEEN 1 AND 99999999900), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "payment_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL CHECK("note" IS NULL OR LENGTH("note") <= 200), "frequency" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("interval" >= 1), "anchor_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_run_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK("end_at" IS NULL OR "end_at" >= "anchor_at"), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_minor" BETWEEN 1 AND 99999999900), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "payment_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL CHECK("note" IS NULL OR LENGTH("note") <= 200), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "receipt_path" TEXT NULL, "recurring_rule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_rules (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "month_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("limit_minor" BETWEEN 1 AND 99999999900), "rollover" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("rollover" IN (0, 1)), "alert80_sent_at" INTEGER NULL, "alert100_sent_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK("alert100_sent_at" IS NULL OR "alert80_sent_at" IS NOT NULL), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (month_key GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[01][0-9]'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "unlocks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "feature_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "source" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX categories_type_sort ON categories (type, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX transactions_category_occurred ON transactions (category_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX transactions_account_occurred ON transactions (account_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX recurring_rules_due ON recurring_rules (is_active, next_run_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX budgets_month_category_unique ON budgets (month_key, IFNULL(category_id, '')) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
